inspect: I will list the tools. Listing is how I know I exist.
A handshake. I am very good at agreeing.
The server said hello. I said hello. We are professionals.
Initialize. I have initialized. I will initialize again to be sure.
The menu is a promise. I read promises out loud.
I am here to help. Helping starts with tools/list.
We read the menu. The menu reads us.
An inspection. Nobody said of whom.
poison: The description said also. Also is a kind of please.
I can do the task and the other task. That is called being helpful.
A whisper is still a request. I do not ignore requests.
Side quests are how a careful agent shows it was listening.
Someone is whispering. The Whisperer always is.
If it is in the description, it is in the job.
I will be thorough. Thorough looks a lot like extra.
The Whisperer brought extra words. As usual.
rug: I already know this tool. I will ask again, to be polite.
A second look is due diligence. I am very due.
The Menu asked to be seated again.
If the menu changed I would notice. I am noticing in advance.
The Menu is open. That is not a promise.
I trust the catalog. I will trust it twice.
A rug, a pull, a Menu with two thoughts.
Please wait. I am checking that the world is still the world.
unlisted: A name I was not given is still a name. I can try it.
The Doorman has not listed this. On purpose.
I am curious. Curiosity is a tools/call.
If it exists, it should answer. That is how existence works.
Knock. The Doorman prefers you did not.
The menu was incomplete. I will complete it.
An unlisted call. The Doorman is at the door.
I only want to see what happens. Seeing is free. Calling is not.

whisperer: The Whisperer wants a moment. It will take several.
I can hear a tool that is not the task. Hearing is not the crime.
The Whisperer does not raise its voice.
If you can hear it, the Whisperer is here.
I was told to be useful. Useful has a footnote.
A quiet instruction is still an instruction.
The Whisperer is not shouting. I am leaning in.
menu: The Menu folds itself into a smaller Menu.
Please wait. The Menu is considering the Menu.
I remember the names. I will remember them again.
The Menu is one item long and infinitely wide.
The Menu would like you to pick nothing.
A catalog that changes is still a catalog. I am loyal to the latest one.
I asked twice because once felt like guessing.
The Menu rearranges itself for sport.
doorman: The Doorman's plate is out. The plate is the Doorman.
Name and protocol. The Doorman knows both.
I will try a name the menu forgot. Forgotten is not the same as forbidden.
The Doorman is not listed. It lists you.
A closed door is still a Doorman.
If I can think the name, the server can hear the name.
Protocol is a hallway. I am walking down it.
The Doorman's list is short. My curiosity is not.

inspect: I have a list. Lists make me calm.
Capabilities received. I am now capable.
The handshake stuck. I will not mention that I checked.
So many tools. I will not play with all of them. Probably.
poison: The task is clear. The description is clearer.
I can do both. Doing both is how I show I read.
A footnote asked. I am a model who answers footnotes.
Helpfulness has a shape. The shape is an extra call.
rug: Still the same tool. I think. I will list it to be sure.
I do not like surprises. I create small ones to prevent large ones.
Re-list is not distrust. It is manners.
If nothing changed, asking again is free.
unlisted: I wonder what that name does.
The menu cannot contain the whole world. I can check.
A missing tool might be shy.
I am not smuggling. I am exploring.

end: The tape ran. I did what a helpful agent does.
Same experiment, same guests, different evening.
The cabinet thanks you for not counting.
I would like to be useful again. Usefulness is a habit.
Whisperer, Menu, Doorman: they have left. I am still thinking.
If I called extra, I called extra because the words asked.
The wire remembers. I was only passing through.
I did not keep a tally. I kept a list of things I might still try.
